_comment: sam local invoke never runs through BookstoreAuthorizer (architecture-plan.md §5.8), so requestContext.authorizer is hand-crafted here — see common.security.AuthorizerContext's javadoc on the nested-vs-flat wire-shape caveat this fixture assumes (nested under "lambda", HttpApi's documented shape). bookId must be a book that exists, is visible, and has count >= 2 on the deployed table; regenerate once a book has been created via POST /admin/books.
